# Claim and forecast ledger

## Responsibility and zero-admission baseline

This ledger preserves why an interpretation is held, what could weaken it, how it changes and where the full argument can be retrieved. It also preserves prospective forecasts separately from later adjudications. It does not replace full readings or specialist prose.

**Baseline SBY-CLAIM-BASE-000, 2026-11-13:** no admitted narrative, no literary claims, no predictions, no adjudications, no revised interpretations and no operational model. Source facts and unresolved audit obligations belong to the [source register](SHIBOYUGI_SOURCE_REGISTER.md). Title-prompted design questions in the method are not hypotheses pretending to arise from source reading.

At the November 13 baseline the narrative boundary and high-water mark were NONE. No record is created merely to demonstrate a schema. The contracts below initialize the required day-one responsibility without inventing content.

## Claim identity and scope

Allocate a stable SBY-C identifier to a real material claim when its argument is first written. Keep the ID across revision; changes to wording or confidence do not make the prior argument disappear. If one claim splits into genuinely different propositions, preserve the predecessor and name each successor's distinct scope.

A claim's header binds its exact proposition, subject(s), source witness/components, temporal/disclosure boundary, evidence class, confidence, current authority home and status. Distinguish direct observation, self-report, narrator presentation, inference, hypothesis and value judgment. A narrator's assertion and an analyst's endorsement of it are different propositions.

The claim's current route is a mutable index, not the whole intellectual object. Every material entry must expose a stable full-argument path and heading anchor. If the full argument remains in a reading, preserve that prose and point to it. If a specialist becomes current authority, retain the original argument route as historical basis and identify the accepted successor.

## Full argument contract

For every load-bearing claim, the canonical argument explains:

1. What precisely is asserted, at what source and knowledge boundary, and what is not asserted.
2. The relevant observations and why each supports the claim; who perceived, said, thought or acted.
3. The inferential steps or causal mechanism, with gaps and assumptions identified.
4. The strongest credible competing explanation and the evidence it accounts for.
5. Material counterevidence, negative controls or exceptions, and whether a diagnostic opportunity existed.
6. What new evidence could change the conclusion and which uncertainty remains.
7. The current conclusion's consequences for downstream character, relationship, thematic or model work.

Do not accept a table containing “supported,” a quotation and a locator as an adequate argument. Nor should a mature monograph be reduced to several ledger rows during a handoff. The ledger preserves retrieval and revision; the full prose retains reasoning, scene specificity and counterargument.

A claim that no behavior occurs requires a defensible coverage and opportunity boundary. Failure to find a keyword is not negative evidence. A claim about a rule, incentive or livelihood mechanism must distinguish assertion, belief, observed consequence and interpretive generalization. The title supplies no premises.

## Current status and revision history

Use separate fields for epistemic status, qualitative confidence and revision operation. A claim can be supported but contestable at MODERATE confidence and undergo PRESERVE; those are different judgments.

| Transition | Required explanation |
|---|---|
| PRESERVE | The bounded formulation survives the stated new evidence; explain why it remains adequate |
| STRENGTHEN | Additional diagnostic support improves confidence or scope without hiding the prior limit |
| REVISE | Formulation, mechanism, scope, attribution or validity interval changes; preserve both versions |
| DOWNGRADE | Support weakens or an assumption becomes doubtful; state which dependency is affected |
| REJECT | The claim is contradicted or no longer supportable; preserve its former argument and rejection basis |
| OPEN | Evidence is insufficient or competing interpretations remain live; state what could discriminate |

Each substantive revision is appended with date or accepted transaction identity, earlier formulation, transition, proposed/current formulation, new evidence, contrary evidence, reason, knowledge boundary, full-argument routes and affected downstream homes. The previous version remains recoverable even after rejection.

A material correction must demonstrate evidence, a source distinction or an analytical defect. An unfamiliar style, different model or preferred author is not a reason to replace sound analysis. Supported competing readings may remain side by side; coherence is not purchased by deleting disagreement.

## Prospective forecasts

Allocate a stable SBY-F identifier only to an actual bounded forecast. Before the test evidence is exposed, freeze the exact forecast wording, rationale, governing claim or model rule, allowed evidence, predicted response family or event, discriminating observation, alternatives, confidence, intended test boundary and contamination disclosure.

Forecasts must exclude some outcomes. “Something will change” is not diagnostic. Avoid false precision and percentage probabilities; use qualitative confidence with reasons. Record whether the forecast is about a close variant of observed behavior, an unobserved situation in the same state, or a more distant counterfactual.

Freeze the record in recoverable persisted state before inspecting the testing material. A declaration added after reading is retrospective regardless of its label. If later material is merely available to the session, control exposure and record what was actually seen. A finished unit synopsis or exit ledger must not leak into an earlier-horizon test packet.

Forecasting never authorizes the test source. A later unit, bonus, adaptation or other witness can be tested only within its own authorized admission boundary. Unavailable or unauthorized tests remain unperformed.

## Separate adjudication

Append a new adjudication after the permitted test is inspected. Preserve the frozen forecast unchanged. Bind the outcome to the exact test source, observed result, relevant context, evidence locator, exposure history, alternative explanations and impact on the governing claim or model.

Use SUPPORTED, PARTLY_SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, NO_DIAGNOSTIC_OPPORTUNITY, CONFOUNDED or UNRESOLVED. Explain the fit rather than treating a broad prediction as success after the fact. NO_DIAGNOSTIC_OPPORTUNITY is neither support nor failure; a source may simply not test the proposition.

A retrospective fit is labeled RETROSPECTIVE_TEST and weighted below a genuinely prospective result. It can reveal constraints but cannot become evidence of forecasting success. Later discoveries may revise a current adjudication through an appended correction while preserving the original evaluation history.

## Dependency and contradiction routing

For every material claim, list downstream full readings, current specialist sections, state records, reconstruction rules and synthesis arguments that actually depend on it. This is a semantic dependency route, not an invitation to create empty files.

When a premise changes, identify each affected home, required correction, responsible role and acceptance condition. A central premise cannot be closed by adding a footnote while leaving the dependent conclusion unqualified. Review only affected dependencies and preserve adequate unaffected argument.

For apparent contradiction, check source identity, locator, edition/component, chronology and attribution first. Then test knowledge differences, narrator presentation, assertion versus enforcement, context, material constraint or genuine inconsistency as warranted. Unknown does not mean secretly coherent. If additional evidence is out of scope, retain OPEN and the specific missing observation.

If the source is closed to new admission, revisions within accepted evidence remain possible through the governing correction route. A frozen reading or forecast is not edited; a claim revision or separate erratum supplies the current correction. No closure bypass is inferred from interpretive urgency.

## Claim retrieval and version preservation

A future current index identifies the live formulation and its full-argument route, then links the complete revision chain. Do not delete earlier evidence routes or reuse a stable anchor for a different proposition. When artifacts are superseded, use reciprocal authority metadata and preserve a single current retrieval route under the archive policy.

For an evidence check, retrieve the full relevant passage and context from the exact witness, not only the excerpt carried in a summary. Test suspect locators, disputed quotations, high-impact reinterpretations and representative mature claims. Report the actual review sample and unresolved limits; a bounded audit is not a full reread.

Public records use brief necessary quotations and public-safe source locators. Full text, raw receipts, private IDs and acquisition filenames stay in the evidence plane. Synthetic examples or model outputs are never entered as source evidence.

## Unit closeout and synthesis dispatch

Each unit transaction records claims added, preserved, revised or left open; forecasts frozen or adjudicated; material no-change decisions; dependency repairs; and full-reading/exit-state anchors. It must agree with the [state ledger](SHIBOYUGI_STATE_AND_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md) and current source boundary. An unresolved required revision blocks acceptance of the affected conclusion, even if other work is complete.

Before specialist dispatch, select a frozen scope and supply the claim index, complete arguments, relevant readings, evidence routes, counterreadings, revision history and unresolved obligations. A receiver must be able to recover why a conclusion was held, not merely that it was held. Compact navigation is welcome; intellectual compression that erases evidence or alternatives is not.

At convergence, compare specialists' source boundaries, premises and counterarguments. Resolve real conflicts through evidence or record the remaining divergence. A future full-series argument must integrate the work rather than concatenate summaries of this ledger.

## Editorial and recovery discipline

Apply the named-reference check to substantive argument prose: synopsis/introduction, a middle section and conclusion, expanded across major relationships where needed. Preserve meaningful aliases and concealment; distinguish justified role reference from unnecessary generic labels or incorrect attribution. A changed speaker or knowledge holder is a substantive revision, not cosmetic replacement.

One mutable owner maintains current routing and appends accepted history. Recover from the last accepted transaction and exact authority surface after interruption. The dated baseline remains SBY-CLAIM-BASE-000. Accepted claim states and forecast adjudications are recorded below.

## SBY-V01-CLAIMS — V01 current view and revisions

The following formulations share the V01 main and recorded illustration boundary. Short labels are retrieval aids to the [full reading](readings/SHIBOYUGI_V01_DEEP_READING.md). Each E anchor preserves exact Japanese witness locators, its causal reasoning and credible uncertainty. Accepted formulations are as of V01. Current entries are revisable through an appended record.

| Claim | Formulation, confidence and return route |
|---|---|
| SBY-C001 | **Supported, MODERATE mechanism.** Yūki's account and actions support a sincere conditional commitment to widening survival. Expected reciprocity, private concern, good judgment about material constraints and risk to self each explain material parts. # State and evidence ledger

## Responsibility and current baseline

This is the canonical cumulative home for future subject identities, directed relationships, epistemic state, disclosure/chronology distinctions and material constraints supported by admitted Shiboyugi prose. It links these changes to full readings and exact evidence; it does not replace them with summaries.

The [architecture](SHIBOYUGI_SYNTHESIS_ARCHITECTURE.md) justifies a combined home initially because an action can change a person's knowledge, available choices and relationships at once. It does not assume a cast, institution, game structure or economy. Separate these into new files only when an evidence-grounded retrieval burden warrants an explicit amendment and preserved crosswalk.

**Baseline SBY-STATE-BASE-000, 2026-11-13:** no narrative admitted; source high-water mark NONE; zero subjects, relationship records, event/knowledge records, constraint observations, voice observations and narrative evidence IDs. There are no entering/exit freezes or completed unit transactions. All ten available witness slots remain unadmitted. This baseline records an absence of project evidence, not an absence of characters or relationships in the work.

No empty character table or fabricated sample observation is created. The operating contracts below initialize the required preservation responsibility. First real records must arise in a future owner-authorized unit transaction.

## Record identity and evidence route

Assign stable IDs when evidence first warrants a record: SBY-P followed by a stable numeric identity for subjects, SBY-R for directed relationship histories, SBY-K for knowledge/disclosure records and SBY-S for other state or constraint histories. Never renumber an ID because a subject becomes more important. These prefixes are allocation grammar, not current subject assignments.

A real observation receives a unit-qualified evidence ID in its full reading. Each ledger entry names the current factual or interpretive formulation, evidence class, confidence, actual source component, disclosure frontier, full-reading path/anchor and associated claim ID when an interpretive argument exists. A locator resolves through the [source register](SHIBOYUGI_SOURCE_REGISTER.md) to exact witness/extraction identity.

Use a readable entry title and enough explanatory prose to say what changed and why the record matters. A list of evidence IDs alone is not a state history. Long arguments remain in the reading or current specialist with a verified full-argument link; this ledger preserves the material delta, qualifications and dependency route.

The public ledger does not contain private source object IDs, raw receipts, local paths, source dumps or acquisition filenames. Those remain retrievable through authorized evidence-plane records.

## Named subject identity

A subject entry begins only when the admitted source establishes an identifiable person or a deliberately unnamed figure needing a stable reference. Record the source-established name, Japanese form, meaningful aliases, boundary at which each identity relation is established and unresolved identity alternatives. Do not assign an invented personal name or conflate people because they occupy similar roles.

Keep actor, observer, thinker, speaker, addressee and affected person explicit where attribution could matter. A scene-bound entry can preserve a concealed identity while a later unit-end note records its disclosure; neither rewrites the earlier knowledge state. Narrative-function labels are explanatory tools, not habitual substitutes for known names.

A subject's current view links the full historical sequence of changes. For each supported change, preserve:

| Responsibility | What a real record must explain |
|---|---|
| Situation | Witness/component, scene, interlocutor/audience, ordinary or crisis context and available alternatives |
| Evidence access | Direct action/speech, represented thought, narrator presentation, another person's report or inference |
| Before and after | What changed in state and what remained stable; valid boundary and confidence |
| Mechanism | Trigger, perceived stakes, appraisal, choice and consequence, with explicit versus inferred links |
| Competing explanation | Role, temporary condition, knowledge, resources or relationship context that could explain the same act |
| Counterevidence | Diagnostic contrary cases or a stated absence of opportunity; not merely a missing search hit |
| Retrieval | Exact observation route, full explanatory prose and affected claim/model/synthesis anchors |

Distinguish revealed-not-new information from actual development. Stable dispositions require recurrence or strong explicit support; a single unusual act stays a situated observation. A later interpretation of a prior act is a retrospective annotation linked to claim history.

## Directed relationships

A relationship history is ordered by subject and counterpart. A toward B and B toward A are separate views even when they share an event. Record attested recognition, expectations, trust, dependency, power, conflict, reciprocity, desire or other source-earned dimensions; do not require unsupported dimensions to be filled.

Each change explains what one party knows or believes about the other, what the other party can know of that state, what action or disclosure demonstrates change and what alternatives remain. Mutual language such as “they trust each other” needs support from both directions. A third party's characterization is evidence of that observer's account before it is evidence of the relation.

Link a relationship-conditioned behavior or register shift to the relevant subject state. Do not globalize behavior seen with one interlocutor. Preserve asymmetry and unresolved disagreement rather than forcing each dyad into a single score or stage label.

A relationship specialist becomes justified only when its cumulative explanatory problem exceeds a straightforward set of unit deltas. Its output must recover the underlying directed histories, not replace them with a label.

## Knowledge, disclosure and event time

For each material epistemic change, identify who holds the knowledge or belief, what proposition they hold, how they learned it, confidence in its attribution, the source/disclosure point and any established event time. Separate known fact, belief, rumor, deception, conjecture and reader inference.

Record whether a fact is newly true, newly known to a character, newly disclosed to the reader or newly inferred by the analyst. These are different changes. If event chronology is uncertain, retain relative order or UNKNOWN rather than manufacturing dates.

Prospective entering/exit states and any within-unit freezes remain immutable. The mutable current view may point to a revised retrospective account but must preserve the earlier state and its argument route. Later bonus or adaptation evidence does not silently enter a main-volume knowledge record.

## Rule-like assertions, constraints and material choices

This lane activates only where admitted prose supplies relevant evidence. It does not presume an actual game system or recurring livelihood mechanism.

For a rule-like statement, preserve who asserts it, who receives it, exact bounded wording if load-bearing, purported scope, participant belief, observed enforcement or exception, and unresolved alternatives. Link assertion and enforcement as separate observations. A successful or failed act is evidence about its circumstances; general scope requires further support.

For a material constraint, distinguish actual resources, perceived availability, stated costs, costs borne, institutional or interpersonal pressure and alternatives considered. Explain how the constraint affects a specific decision instead of assigning a universal motive. A title-prompted question is a design question until evidence is admitted.

When an interpretation becomes a recurring rule, policy or thematic claim, register it in the claim ledger with its full argument and counterevidence. This ledger preserves observed state and asserted constraints; the claim ledger owns the changing interpretation.

## Written voice and supporting visual evidence

Preserve Japanese speech observations with speaker, interlocutor, circumstance, speech act, knowledge boundary, exact quotation status and source locator. Link repeated self-reference, address, politeness, endings or diction to state and relationship rather than treating a memorable phrase as a personality.

Narrated thought, free indirect wording, quoted speech and actual dialogue are distinct channels. A private thought is not an attested spoken register. Voice evidence here concerns written expression; performed delivery, timbre and timing are outside the current source scope.

An illustration observation requires actual visual inspection and a component-qualified locator. Distinguish image content from the prose claim it frames or supports. Keep spoiler placement, inspected coverage and unresolved image-text questions visible. An audit's image-decode count cannot populate this lane.

## Updating and preserving the ledger

For each accepted source unit, append a transaction entry naming the reading, entering and exit boundaries, records created or changed, evidence and claim links, unchanged required dimensions and outstanding obligations. State “no material change” with a reason when appropriate; do not append empty records for symmetry.

Append substantive deltas; update the current routing view only after its supporting record is accepted. Preserve earlier formulations and validity intervals. A later amendment names its predecessor and the claim transition that justifies it. Never rewrite an earlier record to make its reader appear to possess later knowledge.

A large reclassification must name affected relationships, chronology, constraints, voice records, specialists and models. Apply supported changes to those actual homes and record remaining work. If an exact source check is unavailable, keep the affected record bounded or open; a confident prose rewrite is not verification.

## Review, freeze and handoff

At a meaningful checkpoint, test identity consistency, directionality, temporal validity, evidence retrieval and whether major recurring observations are orphaned. Sample ordinary and crisis contexts where both exist, favorable and contrary cases, and records whose conclusions changed. A table's completeness is not evidentiary completeness.

The checkpoint routes to a frozen evidence snapshot with full readings and arguments. Its dispatch list can be compact, but recipients must retrieve the actual relevant prose. Keep one mutable owner for this ledger; a specialist returns proposed deltas against the frozen base rather than overwriting the live file.

Future subject readiness records can be maintained here when evidence warrants them, under the [reconstruction contract](SHIBOYUGI_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_CONTRACT.md). They state coverage and gaps, not evaluator grades or owner permission. There are no such records at this baseline.

## Completion and recovery

A unit's cumulative work is complete only when source coverage, full reading, state changes, claim/forecast changes and exit state agree. A missing required change blocks that unit's transaction even if the essay is polished. Recover the last accepted transaction and current source boundary before continuing; never infer progress from an unaccepted draft.

The dated SBY-STATE-BASE-000 record preserves the earlier state. Recover the active frontier through the [current entrypoint](CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md) and the accepted transactions below.

# Synthesis architecture

## 1. Purpose, authority and proportionality

This architecture governs how future readings of **Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table / 死亡遊戯で飯を食う。** accumulate into a recoverable literary corpus. It belongs to SBY-INITIAL, depends on the [method](SHIBOYUGI_ANALYTICAL_METHOD.md), and is routed by the sole [current entrypoint](CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md). No earlier project architecture is superseded.

It satisfies the sixteen responsibilities of the [initiation policy](../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_PROJECT_INITIATION_AND_ARCHITECTURE_POLICY.md) through the numbered sections below. Its authority is bootstrap design and attributed source metadata, not interpretation of unread prose. Architectural availability, analytical readiness, validation, publication and owner run authorization are distinct.

Ten available Japanese novel volumes justify preserving state and arguments from the first future unit, before later evidence could erase earlier uncertainty. They do not justify a separate file for every possible theme, person, institution or game. Two cumulative ledgers and one source register are enough initially. A dedicated reconstruction contract is justified by the campaign's intended future character responsibility, not by a claim that any character is already modelable.

## 2. Source model

The [source register](SHIBOYUGI_SOURCE_REGISTER.md) defines ten supplied witness slots, SBY-JP-V01-W01 through SBY-JP-V10-W01. It records electronic-bonus title labels, live name/size agreement, inherited audit results and package warnings, while keeping all narrative unadmitted. Numbered packaging suggests a candidate main-volume backbone; verified publication order, story chronology and internal section structure remain open.

The source topology is initially one proposed Japanese novel track with unclassified internal components. Main prose, bonus narrative, illustrations, afterwords and previews receive distinct component and admission classes when inspected under an authorized scope. A future bonus is not treated as another main volume or automatically read after the file's final main chapter. Its disclosure frontier must be established.

Other editions, languages and adaptations are outside this boundary. A later comparison track requires witness identity, explicit admission, source precedence and a recoverable alignment; it cannot silently become a second canonical root or overwrite the novel's account. A shared title or apparent parallel scene does not establish identical continuity. Narration and participant assertions remain source-layered evidence, not automatically world facts.

Technical audit claims and actual inspection are separate. The supplied audit reports language and integrity results; this project matched metadata only. The inherited audit cannot close a later reader's source-access, language, illustration or coverage obligation.

## 3. Sequential contribution contract

A future volume reading contributes more than an isolated essay. It supplies a complete narrative account within its boundary, sustained causal/formal interpretation, exact evidence routes, directed state changes, material claim transitions, forecast dispositions, coverage closure and an immutable exit state.

A near-front **Current-unit story synopsis — unit-end spoilers** answers what actually happens, including the unit's ending where established. It follows concise witness and entering-context material and precedes extended interpretation. Finalize it after all applicable prospective captures are frozen. It may not disclose a later unadmitted unit or silently turn testimony into fact. Concrete scenes and physical mechanics remain visible; thematic abstractions do not replace the event sequence. Stable observation references provide unobtrusive retrieval.

The synopsis is distinct from the causal account, the claim register and the cumulative ledgers. The causal account explains changes and alternative explanations; the synopsis enables independent human comprehension. Neither licenses a future or earlier-horizon reader to cross their assigned knowledge boundary.

The closure transaction consists of the full reading plus source coverage, state/evidence deltas or reasoned no-change decisions, claim and forecast changes, exit freeze and entrypoint/high-water synchronization. No next source is admitted merely because the essay is drafted. The method owns the detailed unit acceptance procedure.

## 4. Day-one cumulative homes

The **source register** owns witness identity, availability versus admission, component scope, source obligations and the route to private exact-byte receipts. It contains meaningful current metadata and open obligations, not empty source-lock placeholders.

The **state and evidence ledger** owns cumulative subject identity, character/relationship/knowledge changes, event-versus-disclosure position, and recurring constraints when the source earns them. These dimensions share one home initially because a single action can change what a person knows, how they relate to another person and what choices are available. The ledger indexes full readings and retains short explanatory deltas; it does not replace their arguments.

The **claim and forecast ledger** owns claim history, competing explanations, evidentiary revisions, downstream dependency routing and immutable forecasts with separate adjudications. Its responsibility differs from describing current state: it explains why the current interpretation differs from an earlier one and where the complete argument survives.

The **reconstruction contract** governs later derived use and records today's zero-evidence readiness boundary. It does not create per-character models, evidence dossiers or performance claims now. Named subject records are created only from actual admitted evidence.

No standalone rulebook, economic ledger, timeline, voice ledger, motif index or readiness spreadsheet is initialized. If a recurring dimension cannot be retrieved faithfully through the two ledgers and full readings, an architecture amendment can split a bounded home with a migration crosswalk and preserved IDs. This avoids both premature ontology and later loss of longitudinal evidence.

## 5. Character and relationship synthesis

Character development and relationships are intended analytical responsibilities. The readings must distinguish dispositions, states, knowledge, situational pressures, roles and relationship conditioning, including ordinary-life evidence where the source supplies it. Current plans do not presume any particular subject or cast hierarchy.

Apply the global [self-contained character monograph standard](../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_PROJECT_INITIATION_AND_ARCHITECTURE_POLICY.md#551-self-contained-character-monograph-standard) to every canonical individual portrait. Consider every evidenced subject for whom convergent evidence across distinct contexts or interlocutors, including variation within a concentrated sequence, supports a differentiated portrait. Consider supporting characters and antagonists on the same source-grounded terms. The monograph supplies the complete personal portrait in one document and addresses the policy's coverage responsibilities in connected, evidence-proportional prose. Explain mechanisms and development, Japanese speech and interlocutor-conditioned choices, ordinary and crisis behavior, limitations, uncertainty and meaningful exceptions wherever the source supports them. Use the readings and ledgers for verification and deeper evidence retrieval.

The state/evidence ledger owns the mutable character-monograph qualification view. At specialist readiness, and again after a material change in evidence, record each considered subject's stable ID, boundary, qualification status, evidence-based rationale, largest gaps, next review trigger and path to an actual monograph when one exists. Use the global standard's qualification vocabulary. Qualification carries a production obligation. A qualified subject's sole current portrait at its declared boundary is typed `character_monograph` and lives at `characters/SHIBOYUGI_<stable-subject-slug>_MONOGRAPH.md` under this project root. Create the qualification view when the first real assessment is due. Deferred subjects remain represented within the appropriate readings, ensemble treatment or cumulative evidence home.

Before recording `COMPLETE_AT_BOUNDARY`, preserve separate self-containment and fidelity decisions in the acceptance record and link both from the qualification row. Test the portrait alone against the representative questions in the global standard, then test its material interpretations using the Japanese locators and current claim state. Prefer a reviewer other than the author. Give central or disputed portraits a monograph-only retrieval probe where feasible.

A relationship specialist is earned when a directed relationship has independently accumulating changes or asymmetries that cannot be understood by placing two monographs side by side. It explains each person's knowledge, expectations, dependencies and choices, the mechanisms of change and persistent disagreement. An ensemble synthesis becomes appropriate only when group-level configuration adds an explanatory responsibility beyond dyads.

The [reconstruction contract](SHIBOYUGI_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_CONTRACT.md) separates literary monograph, evidence record, operational model, validation record and use acceptance. A persuasive literary account does not certify predictive validity. A model never becomes evidence for its own source character.

## 6. Specialist responsibilities: required by evidence, anticipated by design

Narration/disclosure and character/relationship integration are required responsibilities of the eventual literary synthesis, because this project is a prose-reading and character-oriented corpus. They may be fulfilled within a proportionate integrated work or by independently justified specialists. Responsibility does not imply an empty specialist file today.

Three additional domains are **anticipated design questions**, not established themes:

- If repeated rule-like assertions and consequential enforcement appear, examine who states a rule, who believes it, how it is tested, its scope and exceptions, and what uncertainty does to decisions. Do not assume a game-system ontology, cycles or a stable institution.
- If livelihood, resources, work, reward, risk or dependency recur, examine actual constraints and reported constraints, alternatives and costs, and how these interact with character choices. The title does not establish economic mechanisms.
- If repeated tensions between moral judgment, survival, responsibility or narrative framing emerge, analyze the competing reasons and formal treatment without equating depiction or successful action with endorsement.

A domain earns mandatory specialist treatment when it recurs, carries independent evidence, materially changes other conclusions and cannot be handled adequately inside existing homes. Record why, its admitted boundary, exact responsibility, dependencies, output path, evidence gaps and acceptance test. A planned domain that the source does not support is retired explicitly. No unit is forced to populate every anticipated category.

Illustration/prose relations, textual variants or adaptation divergence can become specialists only after the relevant evidence is admitted and inspected. There is no mandatory music, acted voice or audiovisual layer for this prose boundary.

## 7. Evidence routing and full argument retrieval

The deterministic route is: current entrypoint → current specialist or reading → stable claim/evidence anchor → witness/component locator → exact evidence-plane receipt. Search hits must pass an authority and source-boundary check before use.

Full readings own detailed observations and interpretations. Stable evidence IDs identify real source-backed records; stable claim IDs identify bounded propositions and their history. The state ledger links a change to evidence and full explanatory prose. The claim ledger links every current formulation to its prior formulation, supporting and contrary evidence, current argument and downstream dependents.

A mature claim cannot be represented solely by a confidence label, a table row or an isolated quotation. Its argument must retain premises, causal or interpretive steps, material alternative explanations and limits. A compact synthesis-dispatch index is a router into the complete corpus, not a replacement for it.

Japanese quotations remain brief and exact where load-bearing; working transcriptions and glosses are labeled. Source media, full prose extractions, private acquisition names, object IDs and raw receipts remain outside Git. A retrieval failure is recorded against affected claims; a missing locator is not invented to fill the table.

## 8. Claim history, correction and supersession

Use PRESERVE, STRENGTHEN, REVISE, DOWNGRADE, REJECT and OPEN with an attributable revision record. Each material change preserves the earlier formulation and full argument route, states the new evidence and strongest counterevidence, explains the change, marks its source/knowledge boundary and identifies affected downstream homes.

The [claim ledger](SHIBOYUGI_CLAIM_AND_FORECAST_LEDGER.md) contains a mutable current routing view and append-only substantive history. Revising the current view never deletes a rejected interpretation, its reasons or its historical validity boundary. Competing supported readings may coexist without a fabricated consensus.

Accepted sequential readings, entering/exit freezes and forecasts remain historical evidence. Correct them through a labeled erratum or current claim revision; do not rewrite them as if the reader always knew the later answer. Supersession between artifacts uses reciprocal repository paths and one current sink under the [archive policy](../../governance/source-policies/ARCHIVE_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION_POLICY.md). A version increment is not permission to alter sealed bytes.

A closure of source admission does not forbid legitimate correction within already admitted evidence. It does forbid acquiring new narrative authority through an erratum. Exact closure and run rules remain owned by the current corpus policies.

## 9. Time, development, knowledge and continuity

Every material state record separates source position, disclosed event time where established, reader frontier, subject knowledge and current retrospective boundary. Unknown event chronology stays unknown. Do not turn late disclosure of an old disposition into a new development or import a current retrospective account into an earlier freeze.

Directed relations, aliases, roles, resources and temporary conditions are state-qualified. A relationship mode observed with one person does not automatically apply to another. A reported rule may be known to a narrator but not to a participant. A belief can motivate action while remaining false or unresolved.

If a later admitted source establishes alternate frames, branches, resets or other distinct states, qualify records by the actual evidence and amend the architecture only as needed. None of those devices is assumed at bootstrap. An adaptation or translated witness cannot resolve the novel's uncertainty without a declared cross-source claim.

## 10. Contradiction and cross-source handling

First test identity, source version, locator and scope. Then distinguish epistemic disagreement, chronology, unreliable testimony, narration, material exceptions, edition variants, component boundaries and genuine inconsistency. Use the smallest diagnostic source review that can resolve the disputed claim within current authorization.

Do not harmonize every disagreement into one coherent hidden rule, and do not treat a conflict as proof of authorial intent. Retain incompatible readings and the evidence each explains when resolution is unavailable. Mark whether the conflict blocks a central argument, one specialist, a model use or only optional enrichment.

A newly verified source variant does not rewrite the original witness. It receives a separate record; findings are scoped to the version that supports them. If resolving a contradiction needs an unadmitted unit, leave the claim open and retain the source obligation rather than crossing the boundary.

## 11. Dependency and convergence order

The operative dependency sequence is:

    reviewed foundation and authorized source scope
      → exact witness/component binding and capability verification
      → ordered unit readings with synchronized cumulative state
      → authorized-boundary completion and architecture/role-gap audit
      → claim/evidence stabilization and frozen synthesis snapshot
      → earned monographs, relationship studies and specialists
      → cross-specialist convergence and required evidence completion
      → integrated literary synthesis
      → scoped validation, acceptance and any authorized release

Character reconstruction branches from an adequate state-qualified literary evidence base. A model can be developed at an explicitly bounded intermediate state, but it does not replace later literary synthesis or certify untested states. Operational use remains separately gated. Later source admission requires its own authorization even if a model's test plan names it.

A specialist may challenge another specialist's premise. Record the evidence and revision dependency, reopen only affected arguments and review dependent outputs before acceptance. Do not append a contradictory note while retaining an unchanged central conclusion. Preserve unaffected substantial prose and historical freezes.

## 12. Architecture amendment and review

Review after the first complete authorized unit, after an actual early tranche or major disclosure boundary, when a new source class is proposed, when repeated observations lack a sufficient home, before specialist dispatch and before integrated synthesis. The first review tests whether the proposed unit, combined ledger and design questions fit the actual source.

An amendment records the problem, evidence, changed responsibility, exact homes, preserved identifiers, affected claims, required backfill and authority consequence. Split a ledger only when its independent retrieval burden warrants it. Add a specialist only when it has a distinct question and evidentiary dependency. Do not add a new directory because another series has one.

INITIAL becomes EVOLVING when source-grounded findings justify adaptation. STABILIZED requires evidence that the mature responsibilities are substantially understood. A release-frozen architecture requires a successor version for material change. Neither source inventory size nor a completed first draft changes lifecycle automatically.

Backfill is bounded to material gaps. Try complete existing readings and retained evidence routes first; reread only the necessary authorized source. Do not rerun the corpus merely to adopt a cleaner template.

**Foundation amendment, 2026-11-15.** Global initiation §5.5.1 (v1.12) adds a binding independently usable portrait standard. Sections 5, 13 and 16 now route qualification, production and separate acceptance results. This preserves the INITIAL design and artifact IDs. The zero-admission baseline entails no scored subjects, changed claims or source backfill.

## 13. Completion gates

**Foundation review.** Method, architecture, source distinctions, day-one homes, responsibility matrix and retrieval routes are substantively adequate; current authority metadata is valid; independent review addresses material defects. This is not narrative authorization.

**Single-unit closure.** Complete admitted coverage, synopsis, analysis, source locators, cumulative transaction, claim and forecast disposition, exit freeze and acceptance checks agree. Unresolved required evidence blocks the affected closure claim; optional enrichment remains visibly optional.

**Authorized source-boundary completion.** The specified run reaches its actual terminal unit, every unit transaction is closed, the committed high-water state is consistent and no next candidate is authorized. Completion of an acquired V01–10 tranche does not establish the official series endpoint.

**Longitudinal reconciliation.** Subject identities, directional relations, chronology/disclosure, knowledge, constraint evidence, revision history and unresolved disagreements can be traced through the boundary. No important recurrent observation is orphaned and no ledger quietly overwrites an earlier state.

**Specialist readiness.** Conduct the architecture/role-gap audit and record monograph qualification with the state/evidence ledger. Define earned specialists and explicit non-specialist destinations, retrieve complete readings and arguments, identify required and optional channels, and stabilize material claims enough for each assigned question. Carry unresolved claims with their limits and record evidence gaps that affect readiness.

**Integrated-synthesis readiness.** The needed specialist responsibilities are complete for their scopes, dependencies and contradictions are reconciled or bounded, counterarguments remain available and source channels supporting central claims are inspected. List outstanding qualified portraits and their acceptance debt. Complete the character layer when every qualified portrait has passed both reviews.

**Validation and acceptance.** Review source-boundary fidelity, full arguments, representative locators and contested/high-impact evidence, named-reference clarity, preservation, and required-channel debts. Reconstruction validation and independent evaluator capability assessment remain separate from literary acceptance and owner-authorized use.

**Freeze/release.** Confirm scope, stable authority routes, exact retained artifacts, approved limitations, listed monograph obligations and appropriate archival metadata. Apply current repository run-stop/terminal-closure rules when relevant; do not create an empty closure record for this zero-reading bootstrap. Release of a foundation does not open source admission.

## 14. Reasoning, stage ownership and handoff

Use BOUNDED_STANDARD for stable source mapping, SUBSTANTIVE_ANALYSIS for future unit readings and interpretive deltas, DEEP_SYNTHESIS for checkpoints, mature monographs, specialists and models, and PREMIUM_QUALITY_FIRST for load-bearing architecture, difficult contradiction adjudication and final convergence. Mechanical hashing uses tools. A class is not a model name, runtime capability or approval.

Prefer local source-capable sequential execution and cumulative maintenance; fresh fully supplied sessions for substantial synthesis; then local evidence completion and designated repository integration. Either adequately grounded environment may author architecture. This bootstrap is local because its current metadata, policies and private evidence are available here. Future capabilities must be observed per stage; no model label certifies Japanese text or image access.

A substantial handoff follows the [contract](../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_ANALYTICAL_HANDOFF_AND_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md): one operational start-here packet, canonical artifact identities/target paths, permitted changes, recoverable authorization, exact base, complete output files and hashes, full required inputs, admitted and inspected boundaries, unresolved obligations with owners, preservation rules and next action. Transfer the full argument, not a summary of it.

The receiver verifies exact bytes, reads full outputs, compares base/candidate/current state, classifies drift and accepts named remaining work before altering a live target. Receipt acceptance, semantic acceptance, repository validation and authority promotion are separate. A fresh session may not overwrite newer ledgers or replace developed prose with a thin recap. Publication remains with the authorized integrator; CI or the owner merges, and specialized registries remain with their designated agents.

## 15. Mutable state and historical retention

The entrypoint, source register and current ledger routing views are mutable within their declared scope. Substantive ledger history is append-only. Forecasts, prospective captures and accepted sequential artifacts retain their historical bytes and knowledge boundaries; corrections attach through explicit errata or successors.

A mature monograph or model has a bounded version and evidence basis. Preserve the predecessor when revising it, with reciprocal supersession and a visible current route. Do not delete materially distinct interpretation because it is older, and do not let a historical “definitive” title override current authority metadata.

Keep operational campaign status, commit IDs and workflow IDs in their actual receipts/history, not in this entrypoint's prose. Private transfer packages and primary evidence never become parallel public analytical authority.
